Professional profile

A logistics professional built for precision.

Ronald brings a licensed customs-brokerage background together with hands-on freight dispatch and carrier operations. He coordinates loads, drivers, and brokers while keeping documentation tight — invoices, duties, tariffs, shipping records, and regulatory filings.

His work sits at the intersection of compliance and speed: identifying discrepancies, maintaining precise records, and moving freight on time across FTL, hotshot, and import/export workflows.
